# Sequence 10: THE FINAL GAMBIT

**Duration:** 01:05:00 (1560 frames, 28 shots) · **REC:** 01:10:11:12 - 01:11:16:12 · **Music:** 10M1 'The Gambit' (merged theme at full force, Thanos motif fighting it; music falls away completely at the collapse so the mechanism dominates; absolute silence on the wave)
